gloss: lending and borrowing; debts and credits

definitions.explanation: The act of lending and borrowing, taken together. Often used of money or favors, and of keeping such accounts balanced between people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{貸|か}し{借|か}りはしない。
examples.english: I don't lend or borrow money with friends.

examples.japanese: {貸|か}し{借|か}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦きちんと→きちんと：00222_kichinto⟧⟦{記録|きろく}して→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧おく。
examples.english: I keep proper records of what is lent and borrowed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{貸|か}し{借|か}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{気持|きも}ちよく→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}える→付き合う：02291_tsukiau⟧。
examples.english: I owe him nothing and he owes me nothing, so we can get along comfortably.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{貸|か}し→貸し：02578_kashi⟧ (lending) + ⟦{借|か}り→借りる：00532_kariru⟧ (borrowing). Refers to the two-way relationship of debts and credits, whether of money or of favors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貸|か}し{借|か}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to be even; owe nothing either way
- ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{貸|か}し{借|か}り: lending and borrowing of money

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧: debt — only the borrowed (owed) side
- ⟦{貸|か}し→貸し：02578_kashi⟧: a loan given; a favor owed to oneself
